name: Antipaladin Bringer of Divine Retribution
body:
There are many militant orders amongst the religions of the world. They make war and crush enemies beneath their mailed boot. However, there are a sect of ordained warriors whose purpose is not to crush the enemies of their deity but instead to mark them with their deity’s disfavor so they know exactly what divine entity is seeking retribution.

Alignment: A bringer of divine retribution is not required to be lawful good. Instead their alignment must match their deity’s alignment. They must still adhere to their deity’s code of conduct.

Mark of Disfavor (Su)

At 1st level, the bringer of divine retribution can channel the power of their god to mark their target with a divine curse. Once per day, as a swift action the bringer of divine retribution places the curse on a target. The target must be of a group that is an enemy of their deity or of an opposing alignment on at least one axis. If the target qualifies, the target must make a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the paladin’s level + their Charisma modifier). If they fail their save, they are afflicted by the curse. This acts as the spell minor bestow curse but lasts as long as a paladin’s smite evil. At 4th level, this becomes the spell lesser bestow curse including the wider selection of curses available. At 8th level, this becomes the spell bestow curse including the wider selection of curses available.

The bringer of divine retribution gains additional uses of this ability at the same rate as a paladin gains uses of smite evil and feats that provide additional uses of smite provide additional uses of this ability. At 20th level, if the capstone adds additional functionality to smite evil, it is added to mark of disfavor instead. This is a curse effect.

This ability replaces smite evil.

Aura of Revelation (Su)

At 3rd level, instead of bolstering allies in the battles against evil, the bringer of divine retribution reveals the location of their enemies. Any creature that is an enemy of the bringer of divine retribution’s deity or is of an opposing alignment to such a god is limned in light as if affected by the faerie fire spell if within 10 feet of the paladin. This holy light is only visible to the bringer of divine retribution. At 8th level, if a qualifying creature enters the radius under the effects of an illusion or transmutation spell that hides the or changes their identity or form, the bringer of divine retribution can make a caster level check using their paladin level and Charisma modifier. If the check exceeds 11 + the caster level of the spell in question, the bringer of divine retribution can see the creature’s true form as if affected by true seeing. If the creature leaves the radius of the aura, the true seeing-like effect ends but it can be reactivated upon reentry.

This ability replaces aura of courage and aura of resolve.

Cursebearer

At 4th level, if the bringer of divine retribution gains a spellcasting capacity, they add all spells from the lathspell spell list with the curse descriptor to their spell list.

Shared Revelation (Su)

At 11th level, all allies within 10 feet of the bringer of divine retribution share in the benefits of the aura of revelation and may use one of the bringer of divine retribution’s uses of mark of disfavor. This special use of the mark of disfavor uses the ally’s class level and Charisma modifier. However, if the ally is of a group that is an enemy of the bringer of divine retribution’s faith or of an opposing alignment, they do not benefit from this ability.

This ability replaces aura of justice.

Aura of Directed Favor (Su)

At 14th level, the bringer of divine retribution and all allies within 10 feet gain a +4 bonus on saves vs. curse effects and all enemies within 10 feet take a -4 penalty against curse effects.

This ability replaces aura of faith.

Aura of the Blessed Mark (Su)

At 17th level, the bringer of divine retribution gains DR 5/alignment. The alignment(s) that bypasses the DR are the opposed alignment axis of their deity.

For example, if their deity is lawful neutral, the bringer of divine retribution gains DR 5/chaotic.

Additionally they are immune to curse effects.

This ability replaces aura of righteousness.
